verdict.rationale: Cekura's own docs describe a first-party cron job feature that runs automated calls on a schedule to check agent status and alert on failure. This is a genuine recurring schedule, not a one-off action. However, the documented scope is limited to scheduled test and monitoring calls rather than arbitrary jobs or workflows. GitHub Actions scheduling is a host-platform capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: scheduling of general workflows beyond automated test calls, documentation of schedule configuration depth (cron syntax, API/CLI/MCP scheduling control), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Cron jobs run automated calls on a schedule to check the status of your agent and alert you if things fail.
Learn how to set up and manage automated cron jobs for your AI agent testing and evaluation workflows.
